answer: The wharf cap is applied at intake and grove reveals the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool thus cannot mint a army of identities in one epoch whatever the capital it holds, because every participant consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. At most 3 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a vine tag. That is 25 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
